name: liquid-glass-mobile-icons
title: Liquid Glass Mobile Icons
blurb: Grid of frosted glass icon cards styled like a mobile control center.
description: A premade layout of liquid glass cards containing icons arranged in a grid pattern, mimicking iOS or Android control center aesthetics.
use_when: Building a mobile control center UI, quick settings panel, or status icon grid.
avoid_when: When you need a dynamic, configurable icon grid — this is a fixed template layout.
a11y: Icons have sr-only labels for screen reader users.
